description: Generated machine-readable reference for writing and inspecting one singular Tileflow map. The document root is the authoring schema.
x-tileflow-refinement-contract: Standard JSON Schema keywords encode every representable constraint. x-tileflow-refinements records the remaining relational checks enforced by the same Core parser and tileflow validate.

strategies.atomic: The nearest declaration replaces the complete inherited value.
strategies.deep: Plain objects merge recursively; arrays and non-objects replace atomically.
strategies.icons: Omission inherits; any declared array replaces atomically; [] selects no icon directories.
strategies.identity: The leaf map owns the value; it is never inherited.
strategies.keyed-resources: Omission inherits. New keys add, existing keys replace atomically, and remove() deletes one inherited entry.
strategies.leaf: Tooling metadata is read only from the leaf and is never inherited.
strategies.lineage: Defines or traverses the map lineage and is removed from the resolved design.
strategies.modules: Omission inherits. A direct declaration replaces atomically; refine() deep-merges records and replaces arrays/scalars; reset() removes one inherited override; disable() suppresses the domain.
strategies.text-assets: One declaration atomically replaces the inherited text provider and removes the other provider kind.

x-tileflow-theme-contract.authority: @tileflow/core defineTheme, resolvedTileflowMapSchema, category-safe style schemas, and theme audit

identity.selector: Each themes object key is the concrete runtime selector used in manifests, URLs, builds, captures, and receipts.
identity.document: theme.id and theme.version are editorial/provenance identity and may differ from the selector key.
identity.system: system is reserved for browser selection policy and is never a concrete theme name or compiled artifact key.

relationalRules.rule: Must name an own entry of themes.
